name: Mahatma Gandhi
bio: Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi was an Indian lawyer, anti-colonial nationalist, and civil rights activist who became the leader of the nonviolent independence movement against British rule.
quote: Be the change that you wish to see in the world.

events.name: Led the Indian independence movement
Started Non-Cooperation and Quit India Movements
Promoted non-violence (Ahimsa) and truth (Satyagraha)

name: Jawaharlal Nehru
bio: India's first Prime Minister and a central figure in Indian politics before and after independence. He was a principal leader of the Indian independence movement.
quote: We live in a wonderful world that is full of beauty, charm and adventure. There is no end to the adventures we can have if only we seek them with our eyes open.

events.name: First Prime Minister of India
Implemented Five-Year Plans for economic development
Promoted scientific and industrial development

name: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel
bio: A barrister and a senior leader of the Indian National Congress, he played a leading role in the country's struggle for independence and guided its integration into a united, independent nation.
quote: My only desire is that India should be a good producer and no one should be hungry, shedding tears for food in the country.

events.name: Known as the 'Iron Man of India'
Integrated 562 princely states into the Indian Union

name: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar
bio: An Indian jurist, economist, politician and social reformer who inspired the Dalit Buddhist movement and campaigned against social discrimination towards the untouchables (Dalits).
quote: Life should be great rather than long.

events.name: Architect and Drafted the Indian Constitution
Fought for equality and rights for marginalized groups

name: Subhas Chandra Bose
bio: An Indian nationalist whose defiant patriotism made him a hero in India, but whose attempts during World War II to rid India of British rule with the help of Nazi Germany and Imperial Japan left a troubled legacy.
quote: Give me blood, and I shall give you freedom!

events.name: Formed Azad Hind Fauj (Indian National Army)
Promoted nationalism abroad to gain support

development: Military and political leadership for independence
Established the Free India Center in Berlin

name: Lal Bahadur Shastri
bio: The second Prime Minister of India, he led the country during the Indo-Pakistani War of 1965. His slogan 'Jai Jawan Jai Kisan' became a symbol of national resilience.
quote: Jai Jawan Jai Kisan (Hail the soldier, Hail the farmer).

events.name: Prime Minister (1964–1966)
Promoted 'Jai Jawan Jai Kisan' during 1965 war

development: Promoted the Green Revolution and White Revolution

name: Indira Gandhi
bio: India's first and, to date, only female Prime Minister. She was a central figure in the Indian National Congress party and was known for her political ruthlessness and controversial policies.
quote: You must learn to be still in the midst of activity and to be vibrantly alive in repose.

events.name: First and only woman Prime Minister of India
Led India to victory in 1971 war, liberating Bangladesh

name: Atal Bihari Vajpayee
bio: An Indian politician who served three terms as Prime Minister. He was a co-founder of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and was known for his oratory skills and moderate policies.
quote: You can change friends but not neighbours.

events.name: PM (1998–2004) and Kargil Victory (1999)
Conducted Pokhran-II nuclear tests in 1998

name: Narendra Modi
bio: The 14th and current Prime Minister of India since 2014. He was the Chief Minister of Gujarat from 2001 to 2014 and is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
quote: India's strength lies in its diversity. The brotherhood and unity among various communities is our greatest strength.

events.name: Prime Minister since 2014
Launched 'Digital India' & 'Swachh Bharat' missions

name: Dr. Rajendra Prasad
bio: An Indian independence activist, lawyer, scholar and statesman who served as the first President of India, in office from 1950 to 1962.
quote: In attaining our ideals, our means should be as pure as the ideals themselves.

events.name: First President of India
President of the Constituent Assembly

development: Guided the new republic in its formative years
